description: This file defines models and logic for HR departments, user relationships, and action window modifications in an OpenERP/Odoo module.

classes.name: hr_department
classes.description: Model representing HR departments with hierarchy and membership management.

classes.name: ir_action_window
classes.description: Extension of action window to modify domain based on department members.

classes.name: res_users
classes.description: User model extension to compute parent and child user relationships.

methods.name: _get_members
methods.description: Retrieve member user IDs for a department based on manager and member relations.

methods.name: _check_recursion
methods.description: Check for recursive department hierarchy to prevent circular references.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Override to modify domain with department members in action window.

methods.name: _parent_compute
methods.description: Compute parent users for a given user based on department memberships.

methods.name: _child_compute
methods.description: Compute child user IDs based on department management relationships.

methods.name: _parent_search
methods.description: Search method to find users based on parent-child relationships.
